velocity_carriers.representation: eight continuous S^2 carrier directions per path and microstep
velocity_carriers.transport: Fourier Cayley phase transport from live directions
velocity_carriers.collision_invariants: mass and momentum projector induced by the same live direction frame
velocity_carriers.initialization: well-spaced spherical frame; it is not a fixed lattice velocity set

paths.T: learned positive duration per complete field path
paths.responsibility: posterior alignment after the next real observation

training.objective: marginal next-observation likelihood plus posterior-responsibility alignment
training.state_rule: carry the terminal field across every update; detach BPTT graph only; never reset the field
training.resume_rule: restore model, optimizer, terminal field, stream offset, and RNG from one same-update checkpoint
training.stream_state: persistent; never reset during ordered language training or evaluation

capability_surfaces.reasoning: Sudoku blank-cell NLL and accuracy through generic ports

language_evaluation.data_split: OpenWebText GPT-2 BPE held-out fixed local sites
language_evaluation.kinetic_state_policy: terminal field supplies NESS DC and Fourier amplitude spectrum; deterministic independent random phase per site; then local warm-in without reset
language_evaluation.gdn_state_policy: saved mature recurrent state followed by the same local warm-in
language_evaluation.target: mean prior/deployed-mixture next-token NLL across fixed energy-aligned warm local sites
